liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (3 reviews): Reviewer ranks the Deal into Let It Grow transition among the best they have heard; Reviewer counts this Let It Grow among the best they have heard [12][16][17]
- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Reviewer says a booming bass drum opens the show and signals a winner; Reviewer says the opening Help>Slipknot>Franklin's sequence begins a little sloppy but tightens up [9][20]
- **Peggy-O** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Jerry's fingerwork in Peggy-O builds gradually to a crescendo; Reviewer says hearing Jerry sing Peggy-O on this tape, their first bootleg, changed their view of music [18][19]
- **Dancin' In The Streets** (2 reviews): Reviewer lists this Dancin' In The Streets among their personal favorites; Reviewer names the funky seventeen-minute Dancin' In The Streets jam as the show's highlight [16][18]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this Estimated Prophet exceptionally funky and ripping, flowing into a standout Eyes; Reviewer praises the Estimated Prophet into Eyes Of The World sequence as outstanding [12][17]
- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the band plays Not Fade Away with extra intensity, as if energized; Reviewer calls the Not Fade Away very hot [12][17]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the powerful ending of Deal [14]

## The recordings

- **gd77-10-11.sbd.cotsman.19290.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 4.4/5 by 47 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard near-flawless, with only a few minor glitches in Not Fade Away; Reviewer describes the audio quality as very good, from one of the best taping years; Reviewer says recording quality is outstanding, but Help On The Way is abruptly cut off in this file [10][16][18][20]
- **gd1977-10-11.152829.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1977-10-11.152639.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 17 songs; 157 min [7]. Said about its sound: Tape damage in one section of Let It Grow was softened by mixing in soundboard [7]
- **gd1977-10-11.sbd.miller.87514.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 4.25/5 by 8 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls this the last Help/Slipknot/Franklin's trio until the 1980s and prefers these versions of all three [9]
- Reviewer thinks Jerry is off and many 1977 shows are better, though the rest of the band is on [14]
- Reviewer ranks this Eyes as their second favorite, behind the one from 9/11/74 [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-10-11.sbd.cotsman.19290.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard source with audience patches, circulated via J. Cotsman, transferred through MR, DAT, CD, EAC to SHN; An updated audience patch was supplied by S. Milewski [1]
- **gd1977-10-11.152829.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  October 1, 2007; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: This repatch of an earlier soundboard patches Not Fade Away using Doug Lamarre's source [3]
- **gd1977-10-11.152639.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown; tape supplied by Doug Lamarre; transferred by SIRMick & Matt Vernon; source: Unknown audience cassettes from the collection of by Doug Lamarre. [7]. Also: Audience-source compilation from two tapes, all files pitch corrected; transfer coordinated by Matt Vernon, sources from Doug Lamarre; A tape flip near the end of Not Fade Away was patched with Charlie Miller's soundboard [7]
- **gd1977-10-11.sbd.miller.87514.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead of the Day: [October 11, 1977](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/10-11-1977/) [22]
- Poster by SoundCloud: [Slipknot! (Live at Lloyd Noble Center, Norman, October 11, 1977)](https://soundcloud.com/gratefuldead/slipknot-live-at-lloyd-noble) [23]
